item.title: Tojita Sekai no Tori Colony
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tiny Bell
  • 発売日: 2013-07-26
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (75 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 閉じたセカイのトリコロニー
  • 英語名: Tojita Sekai no Tori Colony

あらすじ

This is the first game by Tiny Bell, a sister company of bonbon-company.

Minato was confessed to by the new transfer student Nodoka who he had just met. This day was one that he had been longing for. There were awkward and embarrassing moments at first, but he gradually became charmed by her and enjoyed a comfortable relationship surprising to his classmates and osananajimi.
